methodHeading: How I work through difficult problems
methodSubheading: Complex problems rarely arrive neatly defined. The work starts before the solution.

methodStages.title: Figure Out
methodStages.example: The ERP isn't the problem. The process is fragmented.

methodStages.title: Build
methodStages.example: Build the team, system and execution rhythm.

methodStages.title: Scale
methodStages.example: Standardise what works across the organisation.

methodStages.title: Transform
methodStages.action: Change what the organisation can do
methodStages.example: The new way of working becomes the normal way.

experienceSubheading: A career is more useful when you can see the problems behind the titles.
thinkingSubheading: Notes on strategy, transformation, technology, organisations, scaling and the problems leaders don't always have time to think through.
speakingText: Parul speaks on strategy, transformation, technology, scaling, emerging businesses, leadership and building organisations for what comes next.
finalCtaHeading: Have a difficult problem to think through?
finalCtaText: I'm entering the next chapter of my career with a broader operating lens, shaped by building at scale, working through transformation, and stepping into emerging industries where the answers were not already written. I'm interested in consequential problems, ambitious organisations and opportunities where I can help figure out what comes next.
